note: Single listener. All judgments by the author, recorded before the answer key was revealed except where marked. Providers resolved from the seeded shuffle in .scratch/answer_key.json.

jaison-studio.comment: Would fool my mother on a voicemail.

jaison-phone.comment: C is so good, it sounds like me. A and B are good too but sound less like me.

mom-studio.comment: Hard retroflex t preserved on water and waited.

mom-phone.comment: They are all bad. None distinguishable.

dad-studio.comment: Cartesia overshoots, says WOKing for walking. ElevenLabs monotone. Fish sounds like someone else.

dad-phone.comment: Fish is okay but too extreme on 'water', it tries the accent too much. Cartesia sounds like him but subtly different, and is the best. ElevenLabs is very bad.

dad-studio.conditions: After the answer key was revealed. Recorded separately because the ranking moved.
dad-studio.comment: Fish holds his voice at the start and puts too much weight on the accent by the end. Cartesia has some of him in it. Neither is close.

dad-phone.conditions: After the answer key was revealed. Recorded separately because the ranking moved.
dad-phone.comment: Heard Fish and Cartesia as equivalent, with ElevenLabs clearly worst.

test_indian_english.note: Mom (Studio) to Fish. Dad (Studio) and Dad (Phone) to Cartesia. Mom (Phone) had no winner, all three were bad.

rerun_note: The three phone groups were re-judged after a normalization bug was fixed and the audio regenerated. Fresh seeded shuffle (20260731). Partially unblinded: by this point the listener could recognise providers by output character, having heard many samples.
